# Speaker Diarization Core ML Model Notice

Transcriber redistributes the `speaker-diarization-coreml` model pack from
Fluid Inference Community:

https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/speaker-diarization-coreml

The Core ML conversion is based on the Pyannote speaker diarization models and
is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0):

https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

No changes were made to the redistributed compiled model files. Transcriber
selects and packages the files required by FluidAudio's offline diarization
pipeline.

The FluidAudio SDK itself is licensed under Apache License 2.0; see
`FluidAudio-APACHE-2.0.txt` in this directory.
